- Total students: \(60\)
- Basketball team size: half of \(60\), so \(|B|=30\)

  \]

\[
40+30+20=90.
\]

- Exactly one team: \(60-8-x\)
- Exactly two teams: \(x\)
- Exactly three teams: \(8\)

\[
(60-8-x)+2x+3(8)=90
\]
\[
52-x+2x+24=90
\]

76+x=90

\[
x=14
\]
